description: This file defines an interface IAccountGrain for a bank account in a distributed Orleans-based system, along with serializable classes representing transaction events (DepositTransaction, WithdrawalTransaction). It includes method signatures for balance inquiry, deposit, withdrawal, and retrieving transaction logs, as well as transaction data classes used for event sourcing.
external_methods: Task Deposit(uint amount, Guid guid, string desc)
Task<bool> Withdraw(uint amount, Guid guid, string desc)

classes.name: Transaction
classes.description: Abstract base class for account transactions, containing common fields such as Guid, Description, and IssueTime.

classes.name: DepositTransaction
classes.description: Represents a deposit event, extending Transaction with DepositAmount.

classes.name: WithdrawalTransaction
classes.description: Represents a withdrawal event, extending Transaction with WithdrawalAmount.

methods.name: Balance
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves the current balance of the account.

methods.name: Deposit
methods.description: Asynchronously deposits an amount into the account, with a Guid and description.

methods.name: Withdraw
methods.description: Asynchronously withdraws an amount from the account, with a Guid and description.

methods.name: GetTransactionLog
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves the transaction log as a list of Transaction objects.
